distribution: Local build only; not installed in personal Zotero or pushed.
changes: Per-paper classification moved out of settings into a standalone confirmation window
Automatic prompt only after the note is saved and its suggestion and task have completed
One window queues ready papers without replacing the current selection
Closing or deferring leaves categories unchanged; late results respect deferral of the same note
Settings retain only global controls and a deferred-suggestion entry; task/result windows reopen the dialog
Current displayed note/source fingerprint binds confirmation; critical controls remain in the fixed footer
testIsolation: Fresh test profiles skip welcome pages and built-in WinWord/OpenOffice auto-installation; personal preferences were not changed by the preparation script.
